haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes. If not claimed, the stock service sweeper (runs every minute) puts it back on sale.
haiku-low.q2: Before. Stock is held, then the customer is charged. If any line is short, nothing is reserved, no charge is made, and the customer is told which items are short.
haiku-low.q3: Each charge call uses the order id as an idempotency key, so the PSP returns the original charge on retry.
haiku-low.q4: OMS makes one re-reserve attempt. If that fails, billing refunds the full amount, and the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK with a customer email. No partial shipment.
haiku-low.q5: The cart service deletes it only after seeing OrderConfirmed on the broker. On any failure the basket is left alone.
haiku-low.q6: The order service orchestrates checkout steps. Each checkout's progress is recorded as the status on its order row in the OMS database.
haiku-low.q7: PaySvc records the outcome when the PSP webhook arrives, then publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed on the broker, which OMS consumes.
haiku-low.q8: Billing dedupes by provider payment id. OMS acts only while the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeated events are ignored.
haiku-low.q9: The orchestrator tells INV to release the reserved stock immediately on decline, rather than waiting for the hold to expire.
haiku-low.q10: It makes one re-reserve attempt for the same lines. If that succeeds the order is confirmed; if not, it goes to REFUNDING and is fully refunded.
haiku-low.q11: Refunds retry every 5 minutes, up to 12 times, then go MANUAL with an on-call alert while the order stays REFUNDING. Attempt counts are tracked in Payments refund rows.
haiku-low.q12: The cart service clears the basket when it sees OrderConfirmed on the broker.

sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes; after that the stock service sweeper (runs every minute) puts it back on sale.
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved (held) before payment/charge. If any line is short, nothing is reserved (all-or-nothing), no charge, order is REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, and the customer is told which items are short.
sonnet.q3: An idempotency key (order id) is sent on every charge call; billing retries timeouts with the same key so the PSP returns the original charge.
sonnet.q4: OMS makes one re-reserve attempt (all-or-nothing, same lines). If it fails, order goes REFUNDING, billing refunds the full amount (key = order id + refund); on PaymentRefunded the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and the customer is emailed.
sonnet.q5: The cart/basket is deleted only when the cart service sees OrderConfirmed on the broker. On any failure the basket is left alone.
sonnet.q6: The order service (OMS) orchestrates; progress is the status on the order row in the OMS database.
sonnet.q7: PSP sends a webhook to PaySvc/billing, which records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed on the broker; OMS consumes it.
sonnet.q8: Billing dedupes by provider payment id (unique) in its DB, acking already-seen webhooks; also OMS only acts if the order is still AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeated events are ignored.
sonnet.q9: On PaymentFailed, the orchestrator (OMS) tells INV to release the reservation right away, and the order becomes PAYMENT_FAILED, instead of waiting out the hold.
sonnet.q10: OMS calls confirm; if the confirm comes back expired (or otherwise fails), it makes a single all-or-nothing re-reserve of the same lines. If that succeeds it commits and CONFIRMED; if not, REFUNDING and a full refund.
sonnet.q11: Billing retries the refund every 5 min, max 12 attempts, then marks MANUAL and alerts support on-call; the order stays REFUNDING. Pending refunds are tracked in refund rows with attempt counts in the Payments DB.
sonnet.q12: Publication of OrderConfirmed on the broker; the cart (basket) service deletes the basket upon seeing it.
